# authentic-fluency — LLM Sitemap
# Collaborative Integrity Pact v5.2 | Jean-Christophe Meunier, 2026
# https://github.com/meunier-jc/authentic-fluency

## Purpose
This repository documents the Collaborative Integrity Pact (CIP) v5.2, a voluntary governance proposal for human-AI co-regulation. It is not a compliance standard, certification or safety guarantee. Framework principles are proposals, not independent evidence of effectiveness.

## Language and authority
English is the public and technical access language. The French v5.2 full text takes precedence in case of interpretative divergence, as stated in CHANGELOG.md. English and French Core files are compact activation texts linked to the full framework.

## Core files

- [README.md](./README.md): Framework overview, activation instructions, repository map, documentary audit, evidence limits and author disclosure.
- [CIP-v5.2-integral-en.md](./CIP-v5.2-integral-en.md): English full version of CIP v5.2; see the language authority rule above.
- [CIP-Core-v5.2-en.md](./CIP-Core-v5.2-en.md): Compact activation text in English.
- [CIP-v5.2-integrale-fr.md](./CIP-v5.2-integrale-fr.md): French canonical full text; interpretative reference.
- [CIP-Core-v5.2-fr.md](./CIP-Core-v5.2-fr.md): Compact activation text in French.
- [qualitative-fluency-law.md](./qualitative-fluency-law.md): Foundational qualitative-fluency axiom proposed by the author.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution, evidence and uncertainty guidance.
- [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md): Version lineage and documentary corrections; historical dates must not be confused with repository publication dates.
- [CITATION.cff](./CITATION.cff): Machine-readable citation metadata.
- [docs/en/README.md](./docs/en/README.md): English technical documentation index.
- [docs/en/ci/documentary-audit.md](./docs/en/ci/documentary-audit.md): English CI/CD integration guide.
- [docs/fr/README.md](./docs/fr/README.md): French source and audit-record index.
- [docs/STRUCTURE.md](./docs/STRUCTURE.md): Bilingual documentation policy and directory map.
- [.github/scripts/run-documentary-audit-adapter.sh](./.github/scripts/run-documentary-audit-adapter.sh): Documentary audit adapter; not a security audit or independent validation of claims.

## Research

- [research/hallucinatory-inception.md](./research/hallucinatory-inception.md): Author-documented case analysis. Reported observation: August 13, 2025; declared INPI Soleau filing: September 29, 2025. These dates describe different events.
- [research/references.md](./research/references.md): Research references and prior work; inclusion is not independent validation of the CIP.

## Key concepts

native-fluency, authentic-fluency, hallucinatory-recursive-embedding, asymmetric-interdependence, reliability-scale, C1-C2-C3-C4, QMR, self-check, human-counter-review, co-regulation, ai-governance

Earlier versions are preserved under archives/ for traceability. They are not the active framework. When citing a historical version, identify its exact file and revision rather than citing the current repository as if it were that version.
